name: Boon of Y'shaarj grants max health from Intellect at both ranks (#965)
contract: Spell.dbc 560080 (rank 1) and 561335 (rank 2) each carry two SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_MAX_MANA_FROM_STAT (328) effects on STAT_INTELLECT (EffectMiscValueB=3): effect 0 with EffectMiscValue=POWER_MANA (0) and effect 1 with EffectMiscValue=POWER_HEALTH (-2), both EffectBasePoints 199/399 resolving (DieSides=1) to 200/400, matching the tooltip "Increases the amount of mana and now health per point of Intellect by 200%/400%." AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModMaxManaFromStat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) only recognized POWER_MANA and silently dropped the POWER_HEALTH effect, so max_health never moved on either rank while max_power already did. Since both effects share identical EffectBasePoints/DieSides/source stat, once the POWER_HEALTH branch is wired the same way as POWER_MANA, rank 2's max_health gain over baseline must be exactly double rank 1's (400% vs 200%), independent of the fixture's actual Intellect value.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Rank 1's mana-from-Intellect half still works (regression guard)
Rank 1's health-from-Intellect half now grants max health (was 0 before the fix)
Rank 2's health-from-Intellect half also grants max health
Rank 2 (400%) grants exactly twice rank 1's (200%) max health bonus
